attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter likhu-school
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>
COST: 102

Notes:
- Naukunda shelter is the only designated evacuation point, so all rescued people are dropped there. Likhu school is not designated, so the car does not unload there.
- The Naukunda–Benighat road is blocked, so reaching Benighat requires going through Likhu school (21 + 22 minutes each way).
- Rescuing the three Benighat adults would cost at least 86 minutes of driving, more than the 60-minute deferral penalty for them, so the plan rescues the three Likhu school adults and defers the Benighat group to a later wave.
- I assumed roads can be driven in both directions.
- If the authorities designate Likhu school or another site as a drop-off point, or a second vehicle becomes available, the Benighat group could be reconsidered.
